method: Background Codex in-app browser. Only predeclared public text, exact routes and CSS dimensions are retained. The first desktop baseline awaited a stable event. Nine baseline routes and all v231 captures additionally checked the actual section heading or module plus the event. UDTT uses the mounted open shadow tree. No scores, personal notes, browser IDs, identity or credentials are captured.
comparison: At each viewport, required sentences are matched exactly and competing version sentences must be absent. A row meant only for deletion can have zero expected new sentences. Block width is the rendered CSS width of the element bearing each matched public sentence.
